# Accessibility overhaul

*Client industry: public sector | Completed: 2021-06-04 | Evidence id: fullstack:case:p15*

## The problem
The client was a government contractor failing a WCAG audit.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using React, a statically typed frontend codebase, Tailwind CSS. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project passed the WCAG 2.1 AA re-audit.
